name: Source: Pakistan
notes: Official figures are downloaded from the publishers' own data services and calculated by code; interim figures are read from SBP, PBS, Finance Ministry and FBR releases, market closes, and news reports of them. Every figure shows its source.
takeaway: The current account showed a $39m surplus in October, the first of FY27, narrowing the July–October deficit to −$850m from −$1,062m a year earlier. Private-sector credit grew 17.4% in the year to 6 Nov, and car sales jumped to 23,432 in October.
so_what: Remittances of $3.89bn a month are keeping the external accounts close to balance, and firms are borrowing faster despite a 12.00% policy rate. The cushion is thin, though: the weekly price basket was still 11.21% dearer than a year earlier, and SBP reserves, at $21.57bn, remain $1.43bn short of the end-December goal.

commentary.inflation: Inflation was below the 5–7% target band in mid-2025 and inside it from September to February, then rose to 7.3% in March and jumped to 10.9% in April 2026; it has stayed between 9.2% and 11.7% since and eased to 9.6% in October. The State Bank cut its rate to 10.5% in December, raised it to 11.5% in April and to 12.00% in October, leaving it 2.4 points above inflation. Weekly prices of essentials were still 11.21% higher than a year earlier in the week to 12 Nov, so the pressure on households has not gone.
commentary.growth: Factory output in July and August ran slightly above last year's level and domestic cement despatches rose just 1.2% in October, but car sales jumped to 23,432 in October and private-sector credit grew 17.4% in the year to 6 Nov. The IMF expects growth of 3.5% this fiscal year, about the same as last year and well below the 6.2% of FY22: a recovery, but a modest one, and higher interest rates make a faster one less likely.

curve.note: T-bill cut-off yields from the 28 Oct auction, after the October rate hike, against 14 Oct; bond yields from the 7 Oct PIB auction against 18 Sep. Figures from the State Bank's auction results and EasyData; no 2-year bond result has been published for 7 Oct.
